name: MonarchCountrySelect
title: CountrySelect
wrapsNative: MonarchCombobox (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox with androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet) over a bundled ISO 3166-1 list named with java.util.Locale.getDisplayCountry and sorted with java.text.Collator
summary: A searchable picker of a country or territory whose value is its ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, with names in the person's language.
whenToUse: For a country in an address, a billing profile, a shipping rule or a market setting, when the value to store is the ISO code.
whenNotToUse: For a calling code use MonarchPhoneCountrySelect; for a state or province use MonarchRegionSelect; for a whole address with suggestions use MonarchAddressAutocomplete.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCountrySelect(selected: String?, onSelectedChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, locale: Locale? = null, countries: List<String>? = null, exclude: List<String> = emptyList(), priority: List<String> = emptyList(), presentation: MonarchComboboxPresentation = MonarchComboboxPresentation.Automatic, enabled: Boolean = true, showCode: Boolean = true, showFlag: Boolean = false, countryName: ((String) -> String?)? = null, placeholder: String? = null, helperText: String? = null, errorText: String? = null, clearOptionLabel: String? = null, clearIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchCountrySelectLabels = MonarchCountrySelectLabels())
class MonarchCountrySelectLabels(label: String? = null, suggested: String? = null, all: String? = null, empty: String? = null, combobox: MonarchComboboxLabels = MonarchComboboxLabels())

options.name: selected
options.description: The chosen ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any case, or null.

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Called with the chosen upper-case code, or null when the selection is cleared.

options.name: locale
options.description: The language of the names and of the sort order. null uses the first locale of the configuration.

options.name: countries
options.description: Limits the list to these codes, such as the countries the product ships to. null lists all 249.

options.name: priority
options.description: Codes listed first under "Suggested" while nothing is typed; each country is listed once.

options.name: presentation
options.description: Menu, Sheet, or Automatic: a menu for up to eight countries, a sheet otherwise.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the list can be opened.

options.name: showCode
options.description: Shows the ISO code at the end of each row.

options.name: showFlag
options.description: Shows the flag emoji at the end of each row. Off by default because TalkBack reads a flag emoji as "Flag:" and the name, repeating it.

options.name: countryName
options.description: The app's own name for a code, such as a legal wording; null from it keeps the locale's name.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Shown in the empty field while nothing is chosen.

options.name: errorText
options.description: An error message; replaces the helper text and is set as the field's error.

options.name: clearOptionLabel
options.description: Adds a first row that clears the selection. Hidden while searching.

options.name: clearIcon
options.description: The icon of a clear button at the end of the field while something is chosen. Monarch bundles no icons; without it there is no clear button.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: the label "Country", the headings "Suggested" and "All countries", "No countries match", and the combobox's own strings.

states.name: closed
states.description: The field shows the chosen country's label, or the placeholder (or the floating label) while nothing is chosen.

states.name: open
states.description: The bottom sheet (or, for eight options or fewer, the menu) lists the options; while nothing is typed the suggested ones come first under their heading.

states.name: searching
states.description: Typing filters the list, best matches first, without headings; when nothing matches the list says so.

states.name: error
states.description: The field has the danger outline and the message below it, and the message is the field's error for TalkBack.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field takes the disabled colors and does not open.

appearance: The field is MonarchCombobox's: MonarchTextField's colors, a surface fill with the input border, the danger strong color in error; the sheet is on the surface color, second lines, hints and headings are muted text and the chosen row's radio mark is the accent strong color. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Built on MonarchCombobox, so long lists open a Material 3 bottom sheet with a search field instead of the web's popover. The 249 officially assigned codes are bundled (the web component's list) rather than read from Locale.getISOCountries, so every Android version lists the same countries; names come from the platform's locale data and may differ slightly from the browser's Intl.DisplayNames. MonarchComboboxOption has no leading media slot, so the web's flag before the name is an optional flag emoji at the end of the row, off by default. The value is controlled only (selected with onSelectedChange); the web's uncontrolled defaultValue is not offered. iOS has no CountrySelect yet; the name is the planned shared one.
accessibility: The field is MonarchCombobox's Material 3 exposed dropdown anchor: TalkBack reads the label, the chosen value and the expand state; double tap opens the list.

Every row is read with its label, second line and hint, and the chosen row is selected with a filled radio mark, so the choice does not rely on color; in the sheet each row is a radio button at least 48dp high.
The headings over suggested and other entries are headings; the no-match message is a polite live region.
The error is the field's error semantics and is shown as text.
edgeCases: A selected code that is not in the list (excluded or limited away) is still listed, so the field shows its name.
Lower-case codes are accepted; onSelectedChange always reports upper case.
Outside English, the English name is a hidden keyword, so "germany" finds "Allemagne".
Accents and case are ignored when searching: "aland" finds "Åland Islands".
Priority codes that are not in the list are ignored.

examples.title: Suggested countries first
examples.template:
MonarchCountrySelect(
    initiallyOpen = true,
    // Open as the web's popover under the field, not as a full-height sheet.
    presentation = MonarchComboboxPresentation.Menu,
    selected = country,
    onSelectedChange = { country = it },
    priority = listOf({{priority.0}}, {{priority.1}}, {{priority.2}}),
    showFlag = true,
    placeholder = {{placeholder}},
    helperText = "Stored as " + (country ?: "nothing yet") + ".",
    labels = MonarchCountrySelectLabels(label = {{label}}),
)
examples.code:
MonarchCountrySelect(
    initiallyOpen = true,
    // Open as the web's popover under the field, not as a full-height sheet.
    presentation = MonarchComboboxPresentation.Menu,
    selected = country,
    onSelectedChange = { country = it },
    priority = listOf("GB", "IN", "US"),
    showFlag = true,
    placeholder = "Search by name or code",
    helperText = "Stored as " + (country ?: "nothing yet") + ".",
    labels = MonarchCountrySelectLabels(label = "Billing country"),
)

examples.title: A short list of markets with flags
examples.code:
MonarchCountrySelect(
    selected = market,
    onSelectedChange = { market = it },
    countries = listOf("GB", "IE", "FR"),
    showFlag = true,
)
